title: Strategic Planning From Planning to Execution
overview: Strategic planning creates value only when it leads to clear choices, coordinated action, measurable results, and disciplined execution. Organizations often invest significant effort in developing strategic plans but struggle to translate broad ambitions into priorities, initiatives, ownership, resources, performance measures, and management routines that sustain implementation.

This five-day course provides a complete practical framework for moving from strategic analysis and direction setting to execution and performance review. Participants will examine environmental analysis, stakeholder expectations, vision and mission, strategic objectives, strategic choices, scenario thinking, initiative design, prioritization, KPIs, resource alignment, risk, governance, communication, execution discipline, and strategic review.

The program is workshop-based and enables participants to build the major components of a strategic plan step by step. By the end of the course, participants will understand not only how to formulate strategy, but also how to convert it into an executable roadmap supported by clear accountability, performance measures, review mechanisms, and corrective action.
audience: Senior managers, directors, department heads, strategy and planning professionals, business-unit leaders, project and program managers, transformation leaders, performance-management professionals, public-sector managers, and professionals responsible for developing, translating, implementing, monitoring, or reviewing organizational strategy.
methodology: The course uses an applied methodology combining short presentations, strategic-analysis exercises, case studies, stakeholder mapping, environmental scanning, SWOT and TOWS analysis, scenario exercises, objective-setting workshops, strategy mapping, initiative prioritization, KPI design, execution planning, risk analysis, performance-review simulations, group discussion, and action planning. Participants progressively develop an integrated strategy-to-execution framework based on realistic organizational challenges.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the strategic planning cycle and the relationship between formulation and execution.
Analyze internal capabilities, external forces, stakeholders, trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop or evaluate vision, mission, values, and strategic direction.
Formulate clear strategic objectives and identify the choices required to achieve them.
Use scenario thinking to improve strategic resilience under uncertainty.
Translate strategy into initiatives, responsibilities, milestones, and implementation roadmaps.
Design meaningful KPIs and targets linked to strategic objectives.
Prioritize initiatives and align resources with strategic priorities.
Establish governance, accountability, communication, and review mechanisms for execution.
Identify strategic risks and develop appropriate responses.
Use performance information to review, adapt, and improve strategy execution.
Develop an integrated strategy-to-execution action plan.
